map_info.name: Rotation: centred blades and a tilted lattice
map_info.description: Reversed centre-mounted blades connect grid levels. Beyond a still landing, four 4 by 10 cube arrays compare x, y, z and combined rotation, increasing ten degrees per row from zero to ninety along +z.

learning_objectives: Climb a centre-mounted blade to a higher grid landing
Read how axis and row angle shape forward traversal of a 2D cube array
Locate a traversal limit in geometry and body movement rather than the axis name alone

map_info.title: Rotation: centred blades and a tilted lattice

documentation.summary: Reversed centre-mounted blades connect grid levels. Beyond a still landing, four 4 by 10 cube arrays compare x, y, z and combined rotation, increasing ten degrees per row from zero to ninety along +z.
documentation.layout: 51 x 60 grid; centre blades at z14, a still landing, then four array bands from z33 to z52. All static landings and side aisles use the source grid.
documentation.objective: Separate the single rotating blade crossing from increasing rotation across a 2D lattice.
